caption:
Choice A looks right, but it pays 6% every month.

6% a year compounded monthly means 0.5% per month for 12t months: 2,000(1.005)^(12t).

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Choice A looks right, but it pays 6% every month. Compounded monthly? Divide the rate by 12 and multiply the time by 12.
